title: Quickstart UI screenshot governor and localization-aware crop mapping
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Design a reusable pipeline and small UI 'governor' component for generating brand-consistent quickstart screenshots that are safe for localization and privacy-sensitive content. The goal is to produce assets for docs, onboarding flows, and release notes with: (1) deterministic crop mapping per component/viewport, (2) automated redaction/obfuscation for PII, (3) localized-safe text overlays and RTL support, and (4) configurable brand-preserving filters (color accents, shadow, rounded-crop variants). This ticket covers the design spec, acceptance criteria, prototype assets, and handoff notes for engineering implementation.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic crop map exists for each primary UI component (header, playground, sidebar, modal) and viewport size (mobile/tablet/desktop)
Automated redaction rules mask PII (email, API keys, hostnames) while keeping contextual UI affordances visible
Localization-safe overlays: variable-length text placeholders do not overlap controls in any supported locale including RTL languages
Design tokens are used for brand colors, type, and elevation so final assets match Redwood brand across releases
A small prototype (Figma + exported PNGs) demonstrates the pipeline on three sample screens and is reproducible by the engineering script
tasks: Audit current quickstart screenshot inventory and map to component templates (in progress)
Define crop anchor points and soft/hard crop rules for each template
Specify redaction heuristics (regex + UI heuristics) and masking visual treatments
Design localized overlay system with adaptive truncation and secondary-line wrapping rules
Create Figma component kit with variants (brand, muted, high-contrast) and export presets
Write handoff doc with examples, CI-friendly naming conventions, and image QA checklist
design_notes: Prefer blurred block redaction (8px gaussian blur + 2px rounded mask) for emails and API tokens so intent remains clear without revealing content
For hostnames and URLs, retain domain TLD and obfuscate inner characters to preserve context (e.g., r*****.com)
Use 16:9 primary crop for release hero images, with 4:3 backup for docs that use constrained column widths
RTL support: flip crop anchor horizontally and verify overlay anchors (left vs right) — create a mirrored Figma variant
Accessibility: ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for any text overlays; provide a high-contrast variant for assistive screenshots
Brand guardrails: preserve primary accent hue (RWD-blue-600) in overlays; desaturate background by 10% when applying light gradient
decisions: Decision: Use a deterministic crop governor (JSON mapping in repo) instead of fully automated face-detection to avoid inconsistent outputs at scale
Decision: Implement redaction as a two-stage process — token-based regex first, then component-level masking if unresolved
Decision: Text placeholders will use locale-specific length assumptions from i18n team; where unknown, prefer multi-line wrapping over truncation
Decision: Asset filenames will follow pattern: onboarding_<template>_<viewport>_<brandvariant>_<sha>.png for traceability
review_feedback: PM (Leah Park): please ensure the pipeline exposes a way to pin live data vs fake data for customer-sensitive flows
Eng (Tomás Ortega): confirm storage size impact of using multiple color variants; recommend on-demand generation for release bundles
Design Lead (Priya Menon): like blurred redaction — ask legal about storing blurred originals vs fully scrubbed exports
Localization (Hiro Tanaka): provide sample long-form Japanese strings for the prototype to validate wrapping rules
implementation_notes: Eng will implement the crop governor as a small JSON manifest checked into assets repo and referenced by the export script (ENG-6123)
Provide a CLI flag for 'localize' vs 'sanitized' runs so product writers can choose whether to include locale text placeholders
Include unit tests for regex redaction rules and snapshot tests for exported PNGs at three viewport sizes
Plan for a follow-up ENG ticket to add on-demand color variant generation to reduce storage (ENG-6231)
risks: Automated redaction misses edge-case tokens (risk: low-medium) — mitigate with manual QA step for release images
Localization placeholders break unexpected UI components if content length exceeds assumptions (risk: medium) — mitigate via conservative wrap rules and overflow masks
Storing 'original' screenshots with PII even if blurred may be flagged by compliance — coordinate with Legal and Security
Multiple variants per screenshot increase storage/CI time — engineering to adopt on-demand generation for release bundles
next_steps: Finish inventory audit and pick 3 representative screens for prototype by 2026-03-09
Share prototype with localization and legal for feedback (meetings scheduled week of 2026-03-10)
Handoff Figma kit and manifest spec to ENG-6123 for initial implementation
Document final filename and CI export convention in the handoff doc
